ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed towards low-intensity (black) pixels representing approximately 95% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are localized to the distal tips and sparse focal flecks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous low-intensity field across both lobes. Small, high-contrast focal spots are visible in the mid-left lobe region and dense irregular clusters at the lateral distal margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a deep pixel-depth convergence point relative to the horizontal axis of the fluke tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire trailing edge boundary; the right lobe trailing edge displays higher-amplitude peak-to-valley variations than the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory along the outer trailing edges of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular, high-intensity white pixel groups localized on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, thin, horizontal and diagonal high-contrast linear marks mapped across the mid-region of the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular physical protrusions and scarring on both distal tips corresponding to heavy barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely uniform low-intensity (black) pigmentation across the majority of the ventral fluke surface with minimal mottling.
